The details

Made for a human follow-up.

The kit helps you spot the next conversation. You decide how to respond.

Does it send messages to my leads?

No. It sends alerts and reminders to the configured Telegram chat. Your team follows up with the lead.

How do reminders work?

The monitor checks hourly. By default it reminds you after 24 hours, up to three times, while the lead remains marked new. Change the status to contacted or closed to stop reminders.

Can I customize it?

Yes. The workflows are intended to be imported and configured for your own n8n, Google Sheets and Telegram accounts.

How do I get the kit?

Send an enquiry to ask about pricing and setup. There is no automated checkout on this page.
